phase: 2: before external primary-study full text and result extraction
not_blinded: Candidate names come from prior model knowledge, not an observed search ranking. Inclusion and results are unverified. Search abstracts can expose results; those later exposures must be logged.

fixed_expectations.H1: Search/example assistance may lower bounded-task time, but interface, corpus and instruction may co-vary.
fixed_expectations.H2: Examples may increase imitation, error or fixation. Faster submission is not necessarily higher quality.
fixed_expectations.H3: Initial completion time cannot establish avoided post-adoption redesign without follow-up.
fixed_expectations.H4: Prior expertise/knowledge may reduce or reverse benefit; transfer from other domains requires separate testing.

eligibility_before_results: 2005-2025 primary human study with actual task observations. Preserve non-time studies and no-control studies as adjacent evidence. Search expansion follows SCOPE; cannot select by positive effect.

artifact_plan: Find 8 independently substantive author-provided task/protocol/rubric/data/codebook originals connected to included study families. Do not count manuscript pages or investigator-created extraction tables as artifacts.
rework_start: first accepted/submitted solution or design; subsequent reversal must be observed, not inferred from initial task duration
rule_for_new_candidates: Log discovery method and result exposure before extracting effects. A prospective amendment is not retrospective blinding.
